steps.note: Start the eRFX creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the event item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the event.
Publish the configured event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the RFQ-only clause is absent from the Technical stage.
Verify the second RFQ-only clause is absent from the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should appear.
Verify the first optional clause is visible on the RFQ bid screen.
Verify the second optional clause is visible on the RFQ bid screen.
Submit a quote without accepting the optional clauses.
Confirm the vendor submission succeeded.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
